title: AnalysisResult
description: Consolidated outcome of an endpoint analysis job across detection engines.

job_id.description: Unique identifier of the completed or running analysis job.

analysis_status.description: Lifecycle state of the analysis job execution.

verdict.description: Evaluated threat verdict, or null if analysis is incomplete/failed.

risk_score.description: Composite normalized risk score from 0.0 to 100.0, or null.

modules_executed.description: List of detection module identifiers that executed successfully.

modules_skipped.description: List of detection module identifiers skipped due to eligibility or policy.

modules_failed.description: List of detection module identifiers that encountered runtime errors.

evidence_ids.description: List of evidence UUIDs generated during this analysis job.

hash_reputation.description: Local hash-reputation evaluation summary, if performed.

is_known.description: Whether the hash was found in the reputation database.

verdict.description: Reputation verdict configured for this hash, or null if unknown.

list_type.description: Reputation list classification, or null if unknown.

ml_detection.description: Static PE machine learning inference outcome, if performed.

model_id.description: Identifier of the ML model evaluated.

model_version.description: Version string of the ML model evaluated.

artifact_hash.description: Canonical SHA-256 digest of the model artifact file.

feature_schema.description: Static PE feature extraction schema version.

malicious_probability.description: Estimated probability that the executable is malicious.

benign_probability.description: Estimated probability that the executable is benign.

operating_threshold.description: Decision threshold applied to evaluate predicted_label.

inference_duration_ms.description: Elapsed inference execution time in milliseconds.

is_degraded.description: Whether inference operated in degraded mode.
